recipes.name: Chateaubriand Steak inspired by The Matrix
instructions: For Beef Tenderloin Sear:

Begin by trussing your filet mignon cut (see episode for how-to), then salt liberally with kosher salt and black pepper. Place in the fridge for 24 hours. - 1 beef tenderloin - Kosher salt - Ground pepper - Butcher’s twine

Heat some vegetable oil in a stainless steel roaster until it just starts to smoke and then drop the beef inside. Let it sit for a solid 2-3 minutes to develop some good color on the outside. Flip and sear on the other side. - Vegetable oil
Insert temperature probe into the beef and place in a 450°F oven.

While beef is in the oven, place some cippolini onions into a bowl and place in the microwave for 1 minute. Toss them in some vegetable oil and then add them to a preheated baking sheet. Place in the oven for a few minutes and flip once they get brown and return to oven for a few more minutes. - Cippolini onions - Vegetable oil
Remove tenderloin from the oven after 20-25 minutes, or once the internal steak temperature is 115°F. Let rest for at least 10 minutes.

To the roaster pan, add grated shallots, chicken stock and red wine then boil it down to a syrup consistency. Turn off the heat and add butter. Whisk together and you’ve got a pan sauce. - Shallots - ¼ cup Chicken stock - ¼ cup Red wine - 1 tbsp Butter
Plate with cippolini onions and pan sauce. Serve and enjoy.
For Beef Tenderloin Reverse Sear:

Begin by trussing the tenderloin (see episode for how-to), then salt liberally with kosher salt and black pepper. Place in the fridge for 24 hours. - 1 beef tenderloin - Butcher’s twine - Kosher salt - Ground pepper
Place beef on a rack on top of a stainless steel roaster and place in a 225°F oven for 2-3 hours or until internal temperature reaches 115°F.
Add some vegetable oil to a pan and sear the outside of the tenderloin on each side. - Vegetable oil
Once seared, remove from pan and set aside for 10 minutes to rest.

Add some chopped mushrooms, thyme, and minced garlic to the pan you seared the tenderloin in. Add a little sherry and chicken stock, then mix until a syrup consistency forms. Turn off the heat and add butter and whisk until well combined. - Mushrooms - 1 tbsp Thyme - 1 clove Crushed garlic - Sherry - ¼ cup Chicken stock - 1 tbsp Butter
Cut tenderloin, add mushrooms and sauce, then top with parsley. Serve and enjoy! - Parsley
For Filet Mignon:
Season your filet with salt and ground pepper. - 1 filet mignon steak - Kosher salt - Ground pepper
Add vegetable oil to a hot pan and then add your filet mignon. Sear on all sides evenly to form a good crust. - Vegetable oil

Add in garlic, thyme, and a little bit of chicken stock. Reduce the heat and let the steak come up to temperature (115°F). Remove from pan and let rest. - 2 whole garlic clove - 1 sprig Thyme - Chicken stock
Make the gremolata: Mix together equal parts parsley, capers, and lemon zest. - Parsley - Capers - Lemon zest
Slice across the grain, top with gremolata, and spoon some sauce from the pan around the plate along with some olive oil. - Olive oil
Serve and enjoy!
